column1: # Frozen official NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 bytes (-num_threads 1) for -export_search_strategy - (line RG item F1c-2):
# the requests on NCBI's cout, with the report on it, in -out F or in -out /dev/stdout, 2>&1, /dev/full and >>.
# Left out: psiblast outfmt 15/16 and the rpsblast organism report of an unsearched batch (LOSAT's refusals).
# Fix round 1 (review 1 B1, S1): psiblast -in_pssm / -in_msa with rounds (the prolog before the request; -, 2>&1,
# /dev/stdout), and a report that cannot be written (-out /dev/full: the requests up to the failed batch's only).
# Fix round 2 (review 2 S1): psiblast -in_pssm / -in_msa with rounds whose prolog comes before a strategy file on
# /dev/full, before NCBI's 803.7 post of the request (setup e9: the database name holds the byte 0xE9; 2>&1),
# and a strategy file with -out /dev/full (empty: NCBI's prolog fails first).
# Fix round 3 (review 3 B1, S1): outfmt 20's line of the field names, which NCBI writes and flushes before the first
# batch and its request: psiblast -in_pssm / -in_msa with -, - -out /dev/stdout and /dev/stdout in every program,
# and NCBI's 803.7 post of a strategy file's request with 2>&1.
# Fix round 4 (review 4 S1): NCBI's exceptions after a batch's request: blastp -subject whose mapped alignment
# starts at the subject's first letter (exit 255; with a batch searched before it, reader messages and 2>&1), and
# rpstblastn outfmt 5/15/16 without the database's frequency ratios (exit 3; env {rps:rps_mini-freq}).
# Columns: name, program, env, stdout, fsize, setup, args, rc
